summary: Shows task-level environment for rbenv: installing Ruby 2.3.1 with RBENV_ROOT, CONFIGURE_OPTS and PATH, using creates for idempotence.
questions: How do I install a Ruby version with rbenv in Ansible?
How do I set environment variables on just one task for rbenv?

answer_card.title: rbenv with task-level environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.command: rbenv install {{ rbenv_ruby_version }}
  args:
    creates: '{{ rbenv_root }}/versions/{{ rbenv_ruby_version }}/bin/ruby'
  environment:
    CONFIGURE_OPTS: '--disable-install-doc'
    RBENV_ROOT: '{{ rbenv_root }}'
    PATH: '{{ rbenv_root }}/bin:{{ rbenv_root }}/shims:{{ rbenv_plugins }}/ruby-build/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}'
```
